item.g:title: The FutureX AI Smart Band TFX5 - Heart Rate, SPO2 & Fitness Tracker
item.g:description: THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 is a smart fitness band, AI fitness tracker and screenless wearable designed for users who want everyday activity tracking with simple AI-powered guidance. Your fitness band should do more than just count steps, and THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 brings activity, sleep, recovery, calorie and wellness information together through the connected TFX Vital App. Designed with a lightweight, screenless and distraction-free form, the band can be comfortably worn throughout the day and night while the app organizes recorded information into easy-to-understand insights based on available synced data. Smart Fitness & Activity Tracking: THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 supports Heart Rate Tracking, Blood Oxygen SpO2 Tracking, Sleep Tracking, Stress & Mood Insights, Recovery Insights, Steps, Calories, Distance and Workout Activity. The connected TFX Vital App allows users to review supported fitness and activity information in one place, making it easier to understand everyday routines and recorded trends. AI-Powered TFX Vital Guidance: The TFX Vital App includes an AI guidance feature that uses available profile information and synced activity data to provide simple and easy-to-understand fitness insights. Users can request a daily wellness summary in which the AI assistant can organize available information such as activity, sleep, recovery and other recorded metrics into a clear format. The AI assistant can also provide general fitness and training guidance related to walking, exercise, workout routines, recovery, sleep and everyday fitness habits. If specific information has not been recorded or synced, the app may display it as unavailable. Metabolism & Nutrition Management: The connected app includes Metabolism Management features that help users organize everyday calorie and nutrition information. Users can view Daily Calorie Goal, Calories Consumed, Calories Burned, Remaining Calories, Protein, Fat, Carbohydrates and Fiber. This provides a convenient way to keep activity and nutrition-related information organized within one connected app. Meal Photo & Calorie Estimation: The TFX Vital App also allows users to capture or upload a photo of their food. Based on available image information, the app can provide an estimated calorie value for the meal. Uploaded meals can be managed through the app for convenient daily food tracking. Calorie and nutritional values are estimates and may vary depending on portion size, ingredients, preparation method and image quality. Women's Wellness Tracking: Designed for both men and women, THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 also includes supported women's wellness tracking features alongside its regular fitness and activity functions. Screenless & Comfortable Design: The screenless design helps reduce unnecessary on-wrist distractions while allowing supported fitness and activity information to continue being tracked. Its lightweight construction makes the band suitable for regular day and night use, including workouts, everyday activities and sleep tracking. IP68 Water & Dust Resistance: THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 features an IP68-rated water and dust-resistant design, making it suitable for everyday activities, workouts, sweat and light rain. Water resistance may vary depending on usage conditions and normal wear. Long Battery Life: The band offers approximately 7–10 days of battery life depending on usage, enabled features, syncing frequency and operating conditions. The included charging dock provides a convenient way to recharge the band when required. A Smarter Screenless Fitness Experience: THE FUTURE X AI SMART BAND V5 combines fitness and activity tracking with TFX Vital AI Guidance, nutrition management and meal calorie estimation in one connected experience. The connected app provides a convenient place to review recorded information, understand daily patterns and access general AI-powered fitness guidance. item.g:title: The FutureX Smart Sleep Tracking Monitoring System
item.g:description: Upgrade your sleep experience with the TheFutureX Smart Sleep Monitoring Device , an advanced under-mattress sleep tracking system designed to monitor sleep quality, heart rate, and body movement without wearing any device. Built with intelligent sensor technology, this smart sleep monitor helps you understand and improve your sleep health effortlessly. Designed especially for elderly care, patients, and individuals living alone , the system provides real-time monitoring through a dedicated mobile app, ensuring comfort, safety, and peace of mind. How to Use Wear the Chest Strap Properly Adjust the elastic belt and position it snugly around your chest, just below the chest muscles for accurate readings. Turn On & Activate the Sensor Slightly moisten the sensor pads and wear the strap to automatically activate the heart rate monitors. Connect via Bluetooth Pair the device with your smartphone, smartwatch, or fitness app (Android/iOS) through Bluetooth. Start Your Workout Begin running, cycling, or training — your heart rate will be tracked in real-time on your connected device. Remove & Store After Use After your session, detach the sensor, clean the strap if needed, and store it in a dry place. Features: Advanced Sleep Monitoring; Heart Rate Monitoring; Contact-Free Detection; Smart App Control; Remote Monitoring & Alerts; Rechargeable Battery.
